name: CrowdWisdom Trading
description: Crowd sentiment per ticker for US stocks, ETFs, crypto, futures and FX: a score from -100 (everyone short) to +100 (everyone long) plus the count of distinct pro traders behind it, for today (get_crowd_sentiment_today) or this week (get_crowd_sentiment_week). No sign-in or API key needed.
author: CrowdWisdomTradingx402
